summary: The narrator wakes at dawn in a stone room atop a pyramid in the rain forest at Baalum, after a night spent waiting out a storm while searching for Sarah. Mist covers the plaza below, and the room's walls are carved with Mayan glyphs and warrior bas-reliefs. He packs his damp clothes and resolves to go see the Rio Tigre, the river Sarah is presumed to have used as her escape route.
one_line: At dawn in a Mayan pyramid room at Baalum, the narrator wakes after a storm and resolves to search for Sarah along the Rio Tigre.
key_facts: The narrator believes Sarah was nearby in the rain, sensing her presence like a sixth sense.
He decided that going out into the storm to look for Sarah was the stupidest thing he could do.
He planned to rest, keep periodic watch on the plaza, and go find Sarah at first light.
He fell into a dreamless doze, lulled by the wind in the giant Cebia trees and forest rain on the roof.
A sliver of sun through the stone doorway woke him as forest birds erupted in celebration.
The dawn sky was described as the purest blue he had ever seen, a swath of artist's cobalt.
Below the pyramid, everywhere was a bank of dense, pastel mist, making the plaza seem to be floating on a cloud.
Sarah had called this place "Babylon", which the narrator describes as ancient and mysterious.
The room's inside walls were embossed with rows of classic Mayan glyphs molded in newly set plaster.
Raised bas-reliefs of warriors in battle dress were beside the glyphs in the room.
The narrator wonders why Sarah would return to Baalum after someone had tried to murder her.
He stuffed his still-moist clothes into his backpack and headed for the river.
The river is the Rio Tigre, located at the back of the pyramid.
The Rio Tigre was Sarah's way out and the only thing he knew for sure she had touched.

entities.name: Sarah
entities.role: the woman the narrator is searching for, who had been at Baalum and had called the place Babylon

entities.name: Baalum
entities.role: the ancient Mayan site with the pyramid where the narrator spent the night

entities.name: Rio Tigre
entities.role: river behind the pyramid that was Sarah's apparent escape route

entities.name: Bell
entities.role: vehicle the narrator rode in on a teeth-rattling trip

entities.name: Cebia trees
entities.role: giant trees in the rain forest whose wind sound lulled the narrator to sleep
